description: This CDS view exposes production version master data for materials and plants. Use it to understand which production version is valid for a product, its lot-size validity, validity dates, assigned BOM usage/alternative BOM, bill of operations or routing/master recipe assignment, production line, production supply area, and related planning or execution indicators.
runtime_notes: CDS API view only. Do not call it as /sap/opu/odata/sap/I_ProductionVersion; execution requires a backend CDS/ABAP SQL-capable channel or an explicitly exposed OData service binding.
